name: Image Folder Batch
author: enoky
description: Queues one generation per image of a folder, all with the same settings and the same audio file.

info_card.description: Pick a folder of images: each one becomes the start frame and/or the reference image of its own generation, using the settings of the Media Generator (or an exported settings file) and one shared audio file.
info_card.details: The generations join WanGP's normal queue.
